Thanks for the ping, Logan. Evan — good to meet you by email.

Short answer: we can support a temporary invoice-only path for pilots up to $10,000 gross with a documented exception and the items below completed. For anything above that, procurement will require a formal PO and standard master services terms.

Required for the no-PO pilot exception (please provide):
1) Confirmed billing entity name and remit-to address (matching W9 or equivalent).
2) Copy of a signed pilot SOW or a one-page statement of work (attachable).
3) Finance contact for invoice processing and a sample invoice.
4) Proof of insurance (General Liability / Cyber) OR a waiver from legal for this pilot.
5) Evidence of payment terms accepted (Net30 standard).

I'll attach our internal checklist to this thread — please fill what you can and return: no-po-evidence-checklist.pdf. Once received, I'll submit the Exception Request (expedite queue) and can usually get an approval in 48–72 business hours for pilots that meet the criteria.

Operational note: exception approval will include a limited time window (we typically allow a single 30-day invoice-only window). If the engagement extends or usage exceeds the threshold, Procurement will require a PO and updated contracting.

If you want to proceed now, Evan, send the checklist + SOW and I'll start the exception.

Cheers,
